comments.author: Caligatio
comments.story: The decline of high-tech manufacturing in the United States
comments.why: Part of a series on US manufacturing and lost tooling capability
comments.text: SmarterEveryDay has a whole series[1] on manufacturing that covers how the US is losing/lost the ability to create tooling. I believe the "Smarter Scrubber" episode[2] is the one that explicitly talks about how not only has the US lost manufacturing capacity but it also lost the ability to spin up manufacturing. The tool and die episode also touches on it[3]. [1] [LINK] [2] [VIDEO] [3] [LINK]
